playbooks.name: new-project
playbooks.title: start a new project until you have something that runs and can be proven

steps.text: **Scope that fits on one sheet of paper** — if an SRS with FR codes already exists, use those codes as the task codes in the task table of `docs/BUILD-PLAN.md` per [`spec-to-code-loop`](../../spec-to-code-loop/SKILL.md). If not, make short codes from the scope (`F-01` …) and write what is done, what is not done, and which behaviours can be read more than one way (for example, a calculator that multiplies before adding, or computes left to right). For items that can be guessed and reversed, choose yourself, then log them in `decision-log` with `(รอยืนยัน)` (pending confirmation). For unknown facts (numbers, names, dates, budget), do not guess the value: put `(รอยืนยัน)` where it is used, and collect them once under "ค้างอยู่" (pending) · **Timeline**: if there is a project plan (`docs/<รหัส>-PLAN-*`) → put the plan's `M…` code in the `milestone` column of the task table · if none → arrange the rows into 3–5 milestones where the user can see results (for example, set up the skeleton + verify → core features → secondary features → review + delivery), with a milestone table and 1 Gantt picture from `diagram-figures` (the picture goes in `docs/figures/`, then link it in `BUILD-PLAN.md`) per the template of `status-report` · a duration the user did not give → `(รอยืนยัน)` · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม (unclear brief: `brainstormer` ตัวใหม่ · timeline: `project-manager` ตัวใหม่)

steps.text: **Choose the least technology that is enough** — use the standard parts of the language and platform before a framework. sub: **Check per milestone, not at the end of the job.** For month-long work checked only once at the end, finding the break point is too late to fix.
**A person's and an agent's pieces must not touch the same file.** The split table must state `files_allowed` with no overlap at all · shared files are written by the lead alone (`team-files`).

**People deliver slower than agents.** Design so a person's piece does not block an agent's piece (people take pieces needing judgement · agents take mechanical pieces) · a person's piece that is `ติด` or overdue → the lead proposes, under "รออนุมัติ", taking it over or sending it to a worker.
**Every day must end at a point where work can be picked up.** No day leaves work sitting purely in chat.

steps.text: Split the work into pieces that each end with a check, record them in the "ความคืบหน้า" (progress) table in `CONTEXT.md`, choose a sub-playbook for each piece, and hand them out to fresh subagents one piece at a time · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม
sub: **Check external tools before handing out the first piece.** For any piece that needs an MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool, load that tool by name with ToolSearch and call it once to test now (before the user leaves). Cannot call it → mark that piece `ติด` at once, with the fix written step by step (which server to connect · how to log in), then carry on with other pieces. Do not call the API directly with curl or a token in a command instead, because that goes beyond the permission the user gave.

who.raw: หัวหน้าทีม

steps.text: Do one piece at a time. Pass the section 4 criteria, then go to the next piece. Breaks twice → split into sub-steps, do not retry the same way · after 3 rounds → record it as `ติด` and go to other pieces · ใคร: workers per the `ลูกทีมต่อชิ้น` line above, a fresh one per piece · check (ตรวจ): per the `ผู้ตรวจต่อชิ้น` line above
sub: **After getting stuck.** Record in "ค้างอยู่" (pending) what was tried · where the problem probably is · what is needed to go on. Keep the unfinished work separately as a draft, not over pieces that already passed.
**A piece that must wait for a stuck piece.** Record it as `ติด` with reason `รอ <piece>` (waiting for <piece>), without trying.
**All other pieces are done.** Have a fresh agent on a larger model try once more from that note (an answer in the inbox → start from the answer).
**Still stuck.** Keep it in the report with what is needed from the user · the user answers later → a new session reads `CONTEXT.md` and continues from that piece.

**Stuck because it must be the user** (a decision · a check by eye or ear · spending money or tokens · endorsing text an agent wrote on their behalf): add a row to the "รอผู้ใช้" (waiting on the user) table of `CONTEXT.md` and go on to other pieces, without stopping to wait.
